description: Get the full public page text (intro, sections and FAQs) of one trip from list_tours or list_golf_trips, by its `slug`: a trip sold on request (`onRequestTrips`) or a coming-soon tour (`holdingTours`). The text is the trip's public page and is safe to quote. It returns the trip's name, `url` and `status` with the text; keep to what the status says: an on_request trip is quoted on request with no published price, so use request_quote, and a register_interest tour is not yet on sale and cannot be booked. Never add prices, dates or availability that are not in the text. For tours on sale use list_tours, which already carries their full detail.

slug.description: The trip’s `slug` exactly as list_tours or list_golf_trips gives it, e.g. "golf-in-argentina".

name: get_trip_details
title: Trip details
